name: agentcap
description: Cap one Codex session's share of your ChatGPT plan quota and stop tool loops, inside Codex. Read-only: uses Codex's own app-server and rollout; never touches tokens or traffic.

interface.shortDescription: Quota cap and loop breaker for this session
interface.longDescription: Type `agentcap 10% 5h` in Codex: this session may use 10% of the 5-hour quota, and tool calls are denied at the limit. Also stops a tool loop (same call 4x) or an error streak (8 failures). `agentcap default 10% 5h` applies a limit to every new session, `codex exec` included.
